### LevelInstanceError

Values: `Ok = 0`, `BadHandle = -1`, `NullPointer = -2`, `NotInitialised = -3`, `OutOfRange = -4`, `Unsupported = -5`, `InvalidArgument = -6`, `AllocationFailed = -7`

### LevelInstances

`public static class LevelInstances` - Place, stream and query level instances: one .ocworld placed inside another.

- `public static int AbiVersion { get; }` - The ABI version the native library was built with: (major &lt;&lt; 16) | minor.
- `public static int Spawn(string level, float x, float y, float z, float yaw = 0f, float pitch = 0f, float roll = 0f, float scale = 1f, int parent = 0, bool packed = false)` - Spawns a runtime-only instance (it is not written to the level) and returns its root entity, 0 on failure.
- `public static bool Destroy(int root)` - Destroys the instance root and everything under it.
- `public static int RootOf(int entity)` - The root of the (innermost) instance entity belongs to; 0 when it is not part of one.
- `public static bool IsMember(int entity)` - True when entity is part of a level instance.
- `public static int Find(int root, string idPath = "")` - The entity at idPath inside an instance: "" is the root, "c3" a child placement, "b2/c9" a placement of a nested instance.
- `public static bool SetLoaded(int root, bool loaded)` - Loads or unloads the instance by hand.
- `public static bool IsLoaded(int root)` - True while the instance's contents exist; false when unloaded or when root is not an instance.
- `public static bool Reload(int root)` - Rebuilds the instance from its level asset, keeping its overrides.
- `public static bool SetPacked(int root, bool packed)` - Switches packed mode.
- `public static bool TryGetBounds(int root, out (float X, float Y, float Z) min, out (float X, float Y, float Z) max)` - The instance's world bounds in centimetres; false when they are not known.
- `public static int Count { get; }` - How many instances exist (nested ones included).
- `public static int At(int index)` - The root of the instance at index, 0 past the end.
- `public static long AssetId(int root)` - fnv1a64 of the instance's asset path, the id its entities' link stores; 0 for a handle that is not an instance root.
